subject: Re: Quantum Lab accelerator — early-access sweetener and license split
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@quantumlab.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantumlab.io
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quantum Lab — accelerator onboarding asks

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the latency numbers. We're finalizing the selection memo for our spring accelerator and have two asks before we commit: one, can you bridge a small early-access "sweetener" (one-off free credits for our first month) so our cohort can prototype without immediate spend? Two, our legal team wants clarity on license split if we convert from promo credits to a reserved Dedicated commitment (we'd prefer a stepped discount over 12 months rather than a flat uplift).

High level: 250k tokens free for month 1 + a conversion path with a graduated 10/7/5% discount tiers depending on committed GPU-hours. Is that something Redwood can support or do we need to approach Sales Ops?

If helpful, attaching our accelerator term summary. We're hoping to close procurement by the end of next week.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Platform Programs
Quantum Lab

Attachments: quantum-accelerator-term-sheet.docx (docx)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@quantumlab.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum Lab — accelerator onboarding asks

Emily — really appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Congrats on the traction with the cohort. Short answers up front: we can usually structure a small one-off credit for month 1 (engineering-friendly) and we have levers to create a stepped discount when converting to Dedicated, but there are two parallel approvals needed: Marissa for commercial concessions and Laura for accounting/tax treatment of credits.

Marissa/Ben/Laura — looping you in. Proposed quick path: 250k token credit (one-time) + a conversion appendix that defines the 3-tier discount percentages tied to a 12-mo commit and phased invoice schedule. Marissa, do you have a precedent file or a recommended phrasing that protects Redwood's usage floors? Laura, any guidance on how we should treat the one-off credit on invoice or if it needs to be escrowed?

Emily — if that sounds ok I'll get a concise MAP drafted today so procurement has something to sign off.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@quantumlab.io>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum Lab — accelerator onboarding asks

Thanks Vivek — sounds reasonable. Quick notes from commercial:

- Approve 250k token one-off credit for month-1 pilot; credit attributable to project "Quantum Accelerator Spring 27".
- Conversion appendix: we can do a tiered discount (10% off list for 6+ GPU-hours/month tier A, 7% for tier B, 5% for tier C) but require a 3-month minimum commitment window and a 30-day notice for tier downshifts.
- Usage floor: to protect economics we'll include a small monthly minimum (equivalent to ~$1,000) for tier A/B/C; waive for first billing cycle if committed within 30 days of pilot end.

Laura — on accounting: if we issue the credit as a contra-revenue credit (applied on first invoice) is that acceptable? If procurement prefers escrow, we can do an escrowed credit with release on acceptance of pilot-deliverables.

I've attached a scoped two-page MAP (proposed-sweetener-scope.pdf) that frames the exact deliverables, acceptance criteria, and conversion triggers. Emily — feel free to suggest edits.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-sweetener-scope.pdf (pdf)
From: Emily Park <emily@quantumlab.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantumlab.io, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum Lab — accelerator onboarding asks

Marissa/Vivek — this is great, thanks. Procurement is comfortable with the conversion appendix language as long as the usage floor waiver is explicit for the first invoice. Accounting prefers contra-revenue treatment (applies easier in our internal ledger), so contra-revenue on first invoice is fine for us.

Two small asks before we hand to legal: can you (1) add an explicit clause that credits expire after 60 days if unused, and (2) include a DocuSign link for the MAP so we can sign and route to our procurement system quickly? If you send the DocuSign I can get signatures from both the program team and procurement by EOD Friday.

If those two points are included, we're aligned to close.

Thanks — Emily
